channel_type.description:
Visibility of the channel. 'public' (default) is visible to every project member. 'private' is visible only to its members. Personal #me spaces are not created here.

* `public` - public
* `private` - private

member_ids.description: User ids to add to a private channel besides the requester, who is always a member. Ignored for a public channel. Ids without project access are dropped.

name.description: Channel name, rendered as #<name>. Normalized to lowercase-dashed.

star.description: Star the channel for the requester when this call creates it. Ignored when the channel already exists, which leaves existing stars untouched.
